title: Owens predicts end of California drought with strange weather and UFOs

tellings.quote: California was experiencing a bad drought at the time." And he said, "I'm going to show you what I can do. I'm going to end this drought, and it it's going to happen within a couple of days.

plain: In 1976, during a bad California drought, Ted Owens, a man who claimed strange powers, said: "I'm going to end this drought, and it's going to happen within a couple of days," and the story goes that odd weather and UFOs followed. Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher with a doctorate who studies psychic claims, tells Michels this from files kept by Hal Puthoff and Russell Targ, two researchers in Palo Alto. If true, Owens predicted, or caused, the weather on cue.
